newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm's Motorola suit in San Diego.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm's Motorola suit in San Diego.

text.p: Qualcomm Inc said a federal court in Chicago had granted its motion to transfer a lawsuit Motorola Inc filed against Qualcomm alleging design patent and trade dress infringement to San Diego.
Qualcomm said it had a complaint it filed earlier against Motorola pending in San Diego.

Qualcomm said had filed for a judicial determination that its palm-sized PCS Code Division Multiple Access digital "Q" phone did not infringe any patents, trade dress or other alleged intellectual property rights of Motorola.

"We are pleased that the Court in Illinois has decided that Motorola's allegations will be addressed in the same San Diego court that will hear Qualcomm's lawsuit," said Paul Jacobs, president of Qualcomm's subscriber products division.
He said the company was ramping production of its "Q" phone at its San Diego factory to satisfy demand.
